steps.title: Setup App Directory Structure
steps.description: Create basic package folders and configuration assets.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Establish build.gradle with compatible target/compile SDKs and native standard libraries.

steps.title: Define App Manifest and Permissions
steps.description: Setup AndroidManifest.xml with required Internet permissions, custom launcher themes, and registered activities.

steps.title: Craft Visual Identity & Themes
steps.description: Implement colors, dimensions, drawable states, and premium design styles targeting the Shozica Premor brand.

steps.title: Develop Core Native API client
steps.description: Create BackendApi.java utilizing native Java HttpURLConnection for register, login, OTP recovery, and CRUD operations.

steps.title: Develop Custom Image Loading Engine
steps.description: Create ImageLoader.java utilizing lightweight async connection pool and bitmap memory-caching to dynamically load premium shoe images.

steps.title: Construct Brand Authentication UI
steps.description: Create LoginActivity.java and matching login layout with custom toggle capabilities for user authentication.

steps.title: Implement Email OTP Recovery Workflow
steps.description: Build ForgotPasswordActivity.java with multi-step interactive container toggling for requesting and verifying password resets.

steps.title: Create Dashboard & Interactive Shoe Showcase
steps.description: Build MainActivity.java which allows user to browse shoe categories, toggle view tabs, and search products.

steps.title: Build Dynamic Multi-Image Gallery Detail View
steps.description: Design ProductDetailActivity.java supporting horizontal multi-angle shoe view gallery, interactive size selector, and add-to-cart controls.

steps.title: Develop Checkout Engine with Offline Calculations
steps.description: Build CartActivity.java with precise real-time calculations for subtotals, tax fractions, bulk discounts, shipping fees, and database sync.

steps.title: Building Shozica Premor
steps.description: Run strict gradle debug build tasks to verify app packaging, assets deployment, and signature.
